crew.overview: Kid is an anonymous young man who ekes out a meager living in an underground fight club where, night after night, wearing a gorilla mask, he is beaten bloody by more popular fighters for cash. After years of suppressed rage, Kid discovers a way to infiltrate the enclave of the city’s sinister elite. As his childhood trauma boils over, his mysteriously scarred hands unleash an explosive campaign of retribution to settle the score with the men who took everything from him.
crew.title: Monkey Man

crew.overview: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents for the weekend. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries lead him to a truth that he never could have imagined.
crew.title: Get Out

crew.overview: Husband and wife Gabe and Adelaide Wilson take their kids to their beach house expecting to unplug and unwind with friends. But as night descends, their serenity turns to tension and chaos when some shocking visitors arrive uninvited.
crew.title: Us

crew.overview: Colorado Springs, late 1970s. Ron Stallworth, an African American police officer, and Flip Zimmerman, his Jewish colleague, run an undercover operation to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan.
crew.title: BlacKkKlansman

details.biography: Win Rosenfeld is a writer-producer and President of Monkeypaw. He oversees the company’s diverse slate of film, television productions, and podcasts. Rosenfield is a producer on "Wendell & Wild" (2021) and "Candyman" (2021), which he also co-wrote. He is also an executive producer on "Nope" (2022), "Honk For Jesus, Save Your Soul." (2022), "Lovecraft Country" (2020), "The Twilight Zone" (2019) and "Hunters" (2020)". Prior to joining the company, he produced digital, social and broadcast content for various outlets including NBC, Slate and NPR, and edited an Emmy Award-winning segment at PBS.
details.name: Win Rosenfeld
